title: Glosso
summary: Learn a language to unlock social media
content: Learn a language to unlock social media | Glosso | Product Hunt Launching today Glosso Launching today Learn a language to unlock social media 41 followers Learn a language to unlock social media 41 followers Visit website Language Learning I'm Glosso. I eat your screen time and make you collect words. Block Instagram, TikTok, X until you finish a 15-minute language lesson. 9 languages. iOS. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Education • Languages Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 44 Day Rank Upvote • 67 points Follow Glosso Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info glosso.fr Glosso Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/glosso Similar Products Laoshi Your Second Brain in Chinese Language Learning 5.0 ( 1 review ) Note and writing apps Mobile editing apps Vocabuo - The vocabulary app Learn language with AI, spaced-repetition flashcards 5.0 ( 1 review ) Language Learning Online learning Flowlingo Get fluent in a language through content immersion 5.0 ( 1 review ) Language Learning News Brill Language at your fingertips Language Learning LelaAI Learn languages by reading real articles Language Learning View more Subscribe Sign in DigitalOcean Serverless Inference — 55+ AI models behind one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API 55+ AI models behind one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment alexandre siguret Maker 📌 Hey guys 👋 I'm Alex, founder of Glosso (and few other apps since 2021). This app came from a frankly embarrassing pattern: I'd open Instagram "for 2 minutes" and lose 45. Meanwhile, my language learning app sat untouched for days. So I asked myself: what if the apps we can't stop opening became the trigger for the thing we actually want to do? That's Glosso. It sits between you and Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, Reddit. Tap any of them and instead of the feed, you get a quick word-matching session in the language you're learning (9 available). Match words for a few minutes and scroll unlock. The tagline is "Earn your scroll." Honest moment: I removed the paywall entirely this morning, yes, on launch day. I'd rather have real users sending me real feedback than €5.99/month from a handful of people. Monetization can wait. Learning what actually works can't. A few things I'd love your honest take on: 1. What did you like? 2. What did you not like? 3. What would make you come back tomorrow and the day after? 4. And the most valuable one → if you tried it and won't open it again, why? Be brutal. That's the answer that helps me build a better version. Tear it apart. Ask anything. Thanks for taking the time 🙏 Upvote (1) Report Share 1d ago Rivra Using social media as a language learning tool is brilliant. It’s high-context and actually interesting. How does Glosso decide which vocabulary to highlight based on a user's current proficiency level? Upvote Report Share 11h ago HwanewKing I think very interesting app because i'm also watching f

summary: Serverless AI workspace with smart routing & MCP agents
content: Mycelis: Serverless AI workspace with smart routing & MCP agents | Product Hunt Launching today Mycelis Launching today Serverless AI workspace with smart routing & MCP agents 42 followers Serverless AI workspace with smart routing & MCP agents 42 followers Visit website AI Infrastructure Tools Mycelis abstracts hardware completely. Instantly spin up open-source models on optimized GPUs, or bring your own keys (BYOK). It acts as a unified OpenAI-compatible API gateway for coding clients like OpenCode, desktop apps, or scripts. Includes conditional smart routing, a vector-powered semantic cache to slash costs, integrated RAG, and native MCP agents (GitHub, Slack, Discord, etc.). Get full control over your AI environment with zero server maintenance. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Options Launch tags: Developer Tools • Artificial Intelligence • Tech Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 40 Day Rank Upvote • 70 points Follow Mycelis Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info mycelis.ai Mycelis Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/mycelis Similar Products Eden AI Seamlessly Merging the Top AI APIs into One 4.8 ( 22 reviews ) No-code Platforms Unified API Hugging Face The AI community building the future. 5.0 ( 73 reviews ) LLMs AI Infrastructure Tools Mistral AI Open and portable generative AI for devs and businesses 5.0 ( 39 reviews ) LLMs AI Chatbots liteLLM One library to standardize all LLM APIs 5.0 ( 20 reviews ) Unified API AI Infrastructure Tools Groq Chat An LPU inference engine 5.0 ( 48 reviews ) Predictive AI AI Infrastructure Tools View more Subscribe Sign in Lightfield — AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Bene Haller Mycelis Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt community! 👋 I spent a lot of time thinking about the mounting expenses with AI over the last few months and came to the conclusion that routing specific tasks to the most optimal model is the absolute best way forward. You shouldn't have to keep an expensive cloud GPU idling 24/7 or write endless custom wrappers just to connect an LLM to your database or tools. That’s exactly why I built Mycelis. It’s an infrastructure-as-a-service platform that provisions open-source models on-demand, manages sandbox environments, and handles per-minute usage billing completely under the hood. The tech stack relies on a .NET 10 backend, PostgreSQL, Qdrant for semantic caching, and a Node.js gateway for Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations. It works entirely as a secure proxy API gateway, meaning you can plug it straight into coding clients like OpenCode or any desktop tool. Everything is fully live in production. What do you think about the hybrid model approach (local IDE + serverless cloud tools)? Would love to get your brutal feedback, feature requests, or bug reports directly at https://mycelis.ai/feedback ! Upvote Report Share 1d ago

title: Skyty Wall
summary: Turn any spare iPad into an ambient flight board
content: Skyty Wall | Turn any spare iPad into an ambient flight board | Product Hunt Launching today Skyty Wall Launching today Turn any spare iPad into an ambient flight board 29 followers Turn any spare iPad into an ambient flight board 29 followers Visit website Skyty Wall turns the iPad in your drawer into a live flight board on the wall. Real-time aircraft overhead, in three aesthetics — LED, split-flap, or minimal. Built for the spare device you already own. €4.99 lifetime, no subscription, no account, no tracking. Overview Reviews Built with Forum Team More Free Launch tags: Travel • Apple Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 45 Day Rank Upvote • 67 points Follow Skyty Wall Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info skyty.app/wall Skyty Wall Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/skyty-wall Similar Products Flighty Flight Tracking Made Easy 4.8 ( 4 reviews ) Travel Planning Travel apps Windy No. 1 Professional Weather App 5.0 ( 4 reviews ) Weather apps byAir Your friendly mobile airports navigator and flight tracker 5.0 ( 4 reviews ) Travel apps Maps and GPS Flight Follower Ad free flight tracking for aviation enthusiasts Screenshots and screen recording apps Social Networking Weather Up Live weather maps, event forecasts, and more! 5.0 ( 1 review ) Weather apps View more Subscribe Sign in Forum Threads p/skyty-wall Kim Engels • 1d ago Launching Skyty Wall Hi Product Hunt, I'm Kim, and Skyty Wall is the smaller, weirder sibling of Skyty the offline GPS flight tracker for people who fly (pilots, passengers). 1 1 View all Lightfield — AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you AI-native CRM that builds itself and does work for you Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Kim Engels Skyty Maker 📌 A second app, a second perspective. Skyty has always been for the people in the seat. Skyty Wall is for the people on the ground, looking up. If you have ever priced a hardware flight board, you know the number that comes back: $499 and up. A dedicated panel that lights up with whatever is overhead. Beautiful — and a hard sell, because most of us already own a perfectly good display that mostly sits in a drawer. So we built Skyty Wall. Same idea, no hardware. The old iPad you stopped using becomes a live flight board on your wall, your shelf, or your kitchen counter.
